hero_kpi_rationale: Organic revenue is the primary indicator of the company's growth, excluding the impact of acquisitions, which allows for a better assessment of underlying operational performance.

kpis.name: Organic Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from existing operations, excluding recent acquisitions.
kpis.description: Measures sales growth from the company's existing operations, excluding the impact of acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in core business activities.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's efficiency in producing or acquiring its goods and services relative to its selling price.

kpis.name: Income from Operations Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Measures the profitability of the company's core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Increase in profitability of core operations.

kpis.name: Net Income Margin
kpis.explanation: Net income as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Represents the percentage of revenue that translates into net profit for the company.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
kpis.description: Measures a company's financial performance by excluding interest expenses, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in gross operational performance.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: EBITDA adjusted to exclude certain non-recurring or non-operational items.
kpis.description: Provides a measure of operational performance by excluding items that do not directly reflect underlying operations.
kpis.signal: Solid operational performance, adjusted for exceptional items.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after deducting capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Represents the cash a company can use after funding its operations and capital expenditures.
kpis.signal: Decline in free cash flow, potentially due to investments.

kpis.name: Acquisition Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue from businesses acquired within the last twelve months.
kpis.description: Indicates the contribution of recently acquired businesses to total revenue.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in sales from recent acquisitions.

kpis.name: Sales per Business Day
kpis.explanation: Average revenue generated per day the company is operational.
kpis.description: Measures sales performance adjusted for the number of operating days, offering a more accurate period-over-period comparison.

kpis.name: Organic Sales per Business Day
kpis.explanation: Average organic revenue generated per day the company is operational.
kpis.description: Indicates organic sales growth adjusted for the number of operating days, reflecting improved operational performance.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in organic revenue adjusted for business days.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.summary: Economic risk is high due to market volatility and uncertainty surrounding macroeconomic trends.
risks.score_rationale: Economic risk is high due to market volatility and uncertainty surrounding macroeconomic trends. The company notes that fluctuations in markets and changes in interest rates, inflation, and trade tariffs could have a negative impact on its results.

risks.title: Demand Dependency
risks.summary: The company is dependent on demand for its products and services, which may vary based on economic conditions and customer needs.
risks.score_rationale: The company is dependent on demand for its products and services, which may vary based on economic conditions and customer needs. A decline in demand could have a negative impact on the company's sales and results.

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.summary: The company operates in a competitive market, where firms must compete to attract and retain customers.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, where firms must compete to attract and retain customers. Increased competition could have a negative impact on the company's sales and results.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.summary: The company has completed recent acquisitions that must be integrated into the existing business.
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed recent acquisitions that must be integrated into the existing business. Difficult integration could have a negative impact on the company's results.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.summary: The company must manage its liquidity to fund operations and repay debt.
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its liquidity to fund operations and repay debt. Insufficient liquidity could have a negative impact on the company's results.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: The company is exposed to interest rate risks that may affect its financing costs.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risks, which may vary based on economic conditions. Rising interest rates could have a negative impact on the company's results.
